actions.description: The ADR is architecturally sound, considers real alternatives, states clear consequences, and is consistent with prior ADRs -- approve it
The ADR has a fundamental, unfixed flaw in its own decision or reasoning -- reject it outright
The ADR's own decision or reasoning needs a real change before it can be judged -- distinct from a named, deliberately out-of-scope follow-on item the ADR itself already scoped correctly

metadata.decision_context: Given a drafted ADR, decide whether to approve it, reject it, or request revision before deciding -- shape independently converged by ADPA and SocialEngage

complexity_profile.rationale: Defaults to true for every policy in this template, learned from a real correction (ADPA's own approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
